critical_code_review_comments: src/notifications.ts is now the ONLY entry point for expo-notifications and uses dynamic import guarded by Platform.OS!='web' && !isExpoGo. Failure paths (_failed=true) degrade silently. Verified via grep — no static imports remain in /app/frontend/{app,src}.

src/voice.ts fetchSrc() passes stream:true to /api/voice/tts and honours res.live=true by building the live-ticket URL. First sentence goes live, subsequent sentences prefetched as files — good architecture for perceived latency.

src/CinematicIntro.tsx has 3 completion paths: silentSkip at 5 s (narration didn't start), NARRATION_CAP_MS at 14 s (hard cap), and speakUri().then(finish) after narration finishes. finished.current guards prevent double-fire. In headless-blocked-autoplay mode we hit the 5 s path — verified.
Live-ticket URL /api/voice/tts/live/{id}.mp3 is REPLAYABLE (second GET also returns full bytes) — this matches spec and is safer than one-shot for retry-after-network-blip on mobile.
